## Headroom Learned Patterns
*Auto-generated by `headroom learn` on 2026-05-31 — do not edit manually*

### Commands
*~1,500 tokens/session saved*
Server binds `127.0.0.1:8731`. Before restarting, TaskStop the running background task (or `kill $(lsof -ti tcp:8731)`) or it errors `address already in use`. Poll readiness with a short `curl` loop against `/`.

### Commands
*~1,200 tokens/session saved*
Start the server with `uv run --quiet main.py` — it self-hosts via `uvicorn.run()`. Do NOT run `uv run uvicorn main:app`; uvicorn is not on PATH and fails with `Failed to spawn: uvicorn`.

### Project Layout
*~800 tokens/session saved*
pysize: FastAPI POC for PyPI package install-size (wheel + deps). Code is `main.py` + `index.html`; SQLite cache (`pysize-cache.sqlite*`, gitignored); `ansible/` holds nginx+systemd deploy. Uses `uv pip compile` to resolve dep trees.
